title: Grateful Dead Live at Legion Stadium on 1970-12-28
lineage: SBD > MR > Cass > DAT > CD > EAC > Samplitude v7.02 Professional > shntool > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with a rough mix but still delivers a blues‑laden set highlighted by “Good Lovin’”, “Morning Dew” and an ethereal “Other One”.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its strong blues numbers, a beautifully understated rendition of “Other One”, a bouncy “Good Lovin’” and a “Morning Dew” that ranks among the year’s best. While the mix is uneven—vocals sit too high and some instruments are hard to hear—the performance shines through for most listeners.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4‑5 stars and highlight exceptional performances; recording issues are noted but not enough to outweigh the musical strength, yielding a weighted average around 4.2.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix is uneven – vocals too prominent, instruments recessed; some listeners need EQ adjustments. Despite these flaws the tape captures the band well enough to enjoy the performance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early portion leans into slower blues feels, while tracks 7‑20 deliver the high points of the night; overall set praised for its cohesive, blues‑heavy vibe.
